out.title: K.K. Maheshwari exits; K.C. Jhanwar becomes Non-Executive Vice Chairman
out.summary: K.K. Maheshwari relinquishes Non-Executive Vice Chairman role effective 1 January 2027; MD K.C. Jhanwar, whose term ends 31 December 2026, is re-designated Non-Executive Vice Chairman from 1 January 2027.
